Name: MarriageableCaroline
Author: inetyoumc
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Caroline has had enough of Pierre.
Her dialogue gives hints that all is not well in her marriage, and perhaps she's finally ready for a change.
The farmer doesn't seem to mind giving Caroline a new home — and maybe even making her his wife.
Marriageable Caroline allows you to pursue Caroline as a romantic partner, date her, marry her, and experience new dialogue and events throughout her relationship with the farmer.
And if things don't work out... Caroline may eventually find her way back home to Pierre — perhaps with a new appreciation for what she left behind.
🌐 The mod includes English, Simplified Chinese (简体中文), Traditional Chinese (繁體中文), and Japanese (日本語).


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]need ContentPatcher[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Caroline is now fully romanceable and marriageable.
New romance, dating, and marriage dialogue.
Custom spouse dialogue and marriage schedule.
Caroline's original Sunroom is used as her spouse room.
Custom kiss animation.
New post-divorce dialogue and story.
After divorce, Caroline returns to Pierre — and may start to realize that perhaps Pierre wasn't quite as bad as she thought.
English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese translations.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6.x
SMAPI 4.x
Content Patcher 2.x[/color]
